ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels to high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels, with high-intensity pixels concentrated in localized scars and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark low-intensity region across the central and proximal areas; high-intensity pixel clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips and scattered in thin linear filaments across the fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with moderate-amplitude pixel variations (serrations) along the horizontal span of the trailing edge, transitioning to high-frequency irregularities at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory on the distal margins of both lobes, resulting in a distinct 'upturned' profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel formations at the extreme outer tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, high-intensity linear pixel paths (scratches) visible on the dark surface, including vertical marks on the left lobe and oblique marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast clusters at the fluke tips; multiple thin linear white markings scattered across the ventral surface.
